values.meaning: detonation delay before the shark erupts
values.quote: chomp at the lure after 2 seconds

mechanics.claim: The shark deals damage to nearby enemies when it erupts after the delay, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: chomp at the lure after 2 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: The shark erupts after 2 seconds, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back or up.
mechanics.quote: attracts a shark, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area before it emerges to chomp at the lure after 2 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}}

mechanics.claim: The farther the lure flies before landing/attaching, the larger the shark and the higher its damage tier (Guppy/Chomper/Gigalodon).
mechanics.quote: The further the lure travels in its initial flight, the larger the shark that is attracted; increasing ''Chum the Waters' '' damage

mechanics.claim: A spell shield or Malzahar's Void Shift blocks the lure from attaching to a champion, consuming the mitigation effect; the eruption still occurs at the target's location.
mechanics.quote: will not attach the lure to an enemy champion if they have a {{tip|spell shield}} as well as against an enemy {{ci|Malzahar}} with his {{ai|Void Shift|Malzahar}} active (mitigation effect is consumed in both cases)

mechanics.claim: The lure missile can be stopped prematurely by colliding with certain blocking abilities, causing the eruption to occur early rather than at the intended location.
mechanics.quote: lure missile will stop its movement upon colliding with {{cai|Blade Whirl|Samira}} or {{cai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} specifically, creating the area of effect for the eruption prematurely
